name: Real Estate & Infrastructure
desc: Developers, landowners and investors across plotted, residential, commercial and township projects — from title diligence and joint development agreements to RERA compliance, allottee disputes and possession-stage litigation.

name: Manufacturing
desc: Plants and production businesses where legal risk sits in the supply chain, the workforce and the licence file: vendor and EPC contracts, land and environmental approvals, factory and labour compliance, and union matters.

name: FMCG
desc: Fast-moving consumer goods businesses working through distributor and channel networks — distribution and stockist agreements, trade terms, packaging and labelling compliance, brand protection and consumer complaints.

name: Consumer Durables
desc: Appliance and durables companies managing dealer networks, warranty and after-sales obligations, product liability exposure, service-franchise arrangements and cross-border sourcing.

name: Retail & Consumer Businesses
desc: Store and online retail operations — commercial leases and leave-and-licence arrangements, franchise agreements, consumer protection and e-commerce rules, payment terms and vendor onboarding.

name: Technology & IT Services
desc: Software, SaaS and IT services companies whose contracts carry the commercial risk: master service agreements, SLAs, licensing and IP assignment, data protection obligations and offshore delivery arrangements.

name: Banking & Finance
desc: Lenders, NBFCs and borrowers on facility and security documentation, regulatory compliance and reporting, recovery and enforcement, debt restructuring and insolvency, and fintech and data-protection questions.

name: Media & Entertainment
desc: Film, television, music, publishing and digital media — talent and production agreements, distribution and licensing, copyright registration and enforcement, content and advertising compliance, and rights acquisition.

name: Start-ups & Emerging Businesses
desc: Founders building the legal foundation as they go: entity structuring and founders' agreements, ESOP pools, term sheets and investment documentation, IP ownership, and the compliance calendar that arrives with funding.

name: Hospitality & Leisure
desc: Hotels, resorts and leisure operators on management and operating agreements, property and licensing arrangements, statutory permits, employment structures and guest-facing liability.

name: Investment & Holding Companies
desc: Holding structures and family investment vehicles — group restructuring, intra-group agreements, shareholder arrangements, FDI and exchange-control questions, and governance across subsidiaries.

name: Metals & Recycling
desc: Metal processing, extraction and recycling businesses operating under a dense permit regime: environmental and pollution-control compliance, trading and offtake contracts, land use and regulatory investigations.

name: Private Clients
desc: Individuals and families on matters that are personal before they are legal — matrimonial and custody disputes, succession, wills and estate planning, property transactions and disputes, and private advisory handled with discretion.
